competition.title: Smoke Competition (Evolution)
competition.summary: Extend the generated counter and dice applications with small new behaviors while preserving their existing features.
competition.notice: Use generated outputs from the Smoke Competition as the starting templates for both evolution tasks.

tasks.title: ARC Counter Evolution Smoke Test
tasks.summary: Extend the existing counter application with a reset control without breaking its increment and decrement behavior.

tasks.title: ARC Dice Evolution Smoke Test
tasks.summary: Extend the existing dice application with a roll counter without breaking its six-sided roll behavior.

flow: Upload an agent snapshot or select a built-in one.
Compile the large requirement into smaller runnable modules.
Run the GitHub-style and spreadsheet-style tasks in order.
Inspect evidence and refine the system until the output is stable.
rules: Treat the requirement document as the source of truth.
Keep changes small enough to verify each step.
Use the task artifacts to explain what your agent changed.
